evidence: A landslide in Tilagufa-7 buried five members of the Bista family; four bodies had been recovered by the later report.
review_notes: Both records describe the 9 Oct Tilagufa-7 Bista household landslide: the existing Ujyaalo report identifies the six missing including members of the Bista family; the candidate is a later recovery update for that event, not Ranchuli.

evidence: A separate landslide in Ranchuli, Tilagufa-4, buried 13 people travelling to a funeral; they were still reported missing.
review_notes: The candidate specifies 13 missing funeral attendees at Ranchuli, Tilagufa-4; the existing 10 Oct OnlineKhabar article explicitly describes that same funeral-procession landslide. It is distinct from the Tilagufa-7 Bista household incident.

evidence: A landslide swept the Upper Tamakoshi headworks power-operation building, leaving four people out of contact.
review_notes: Both records describe the Upper Tamakoshi headworks failure at Lamabagar, Bigu-1, Dolakha on 28 Sep 2024 with two soldiers and two employees missing. This is not the Bhimeshwor house collapse.

evidence: The Kaligandaki Corridor was blocked from Friday by a landslide near Sahardikhola bridge at the Rambha-2/3 boundary.
review_notes: The existing Republica account specifically locates the 30 Jun obstruction near Sardikhola/Sahardikhola bridge at the Rambha-2/3 border, precisely matching this reconstructed event; the 3 Jul district roundup is not the specific anchor.

evidence: A later dry/rocky landslide at Gargare on the Harmichaur-Arbeni road blocked the corridor from Friday June 20; reports differ on ward 1 versus ward 2.
review_notes: The candidate and existing 21 Jun Republica report both describe the ongoing dry landslide since Friday 20 Jun on Harmichaur-Arbeni (Gargare), Kaligandaki-1/2. The ward discrepancy does not establish two physical failures.

evidence: A house in Nanglibang VDC-4 was buried by a landslide overnight; two occupants were rescued alive and human casualty was averted.
review_notes: Both accounts refer to the mid-July Nanglibang-4 house burial, including the named resident Belmati Pariyar. Reports differ on number/name of injured or rescued, but location, person and episode support one physical failure, not the separate Maldhunga slide.

evidence: A separate landslide from Nuwar hill entered the landless settlement at Maldhunga of Pang, leaving residents homeless and at continuing risk.
review_notes: Both accounts describe the continuing Nuwar hill/Maldhunga landless-settlement slide and displacement around 18-19 Jul; no distinct later failure is established by the follow-up. The other July match concerns a Nanglibang-4 house.

evidence: A separate landslide at Sisneri killed six ANFA academy students; the relief article confirms six deaths.
review_notes: The existing Nepal Press article specifically reports six ANFA academy students buried in the Sisneri landslide. The candidate relief report confirms those same six deaths; other matched articles cover subsets/follow-up rather than different physical events.

evidence: A landslide at Kalikhola, Ichhakamana-6, disrupted the road at 5:45 am on May 17.
review_notes: The existing Himalayan Times article and candidate both specify a landslide at Kalikhola, Ichchhyakamana-6, around 5:45 am on 17 May 2018.

evidence: A landslide buried a restaurant in Nagarjun-3; Manoj BK later died in hospital.
review_notes: The existing Kathmandu one-fatality landslide report matches the 6 Jul Nagarjun-3 restaurant burial and Manoj BK death. It is separate from Tarakeshwar, Dakshinkali and Lalitpur sites mentioned in the aggregate source.
